# PersianBlocker Snapshot

This directory contains a vendored snapshot of selected host/domain lists from
the PersianBlocker project so RelayBridge can start with ad blocking enabled
when `raw.githubusercontent.com` is unavailable.

Upstream project: https://github.com/MasterKia/PersianBlocker

Included snapshot files:

- `PersianBlockerAds-Hosts.txt`
- `PersianBlockerTrackers-Hosts.txt`
- `PersianBlockerAnnoyances-Domains.txt`
- `PersianBlockerHosts.txt`
